messages:
maria: Quick FYI — we lack clear telemetry for mixed-dim embedding traffic. Console only shows request count and total bytes; we can't see per-embedding dim distribution which is driving a lot of routing/quotas pain.

alex: +1. We've been blind to variance. Ops sees spikes where a few tenants send many 4096-dim vectors and blow up unit usage.

sam: Proposal: add an optional client header `X-Embed-Unit-Estimate` so SDKs can hint estimated units for the batch. Server falls back to current heuristic when absent. header format example: `X-Embed-Unit-Estimate: units=12;shape=4x768`

jordan: I like a hint header, but we need strict validation and a metric to track mismatch between header and actual cost. Otherwise tenants will patch fake numbers.

maria: Agreed. Plan: (1) accept header as best-effort, (2) compute actual units server-side, (3) emit telemetry `embed.unit.hint` with fields [hint_present, hint_units, actual_units, tenant_id]. Alert if median(|hint - actual|) > 20% per-tenant.

lee: Console work: new dashboard panel "Embed unit heatmap" (rows=tenant, cols=bucketed unit estimate 1/2/4/8/16). Also a per-route timeseries of hint vs actual so SEs can triage.

alex: How will this affect routing decisions? If header is present should runtime use it to pick route/shard? I worry about trusting untrusted hints for placement.

maria: Short answer: no. Hint only for telemetry and fastpath estimates. Routing will continue to use server-side calculated units for enforcement. We can add an opt-in runtime flag for internal customers to enable hint-driven routing after a 2-week trust calibration window.

sam: Backcompat: SDKs will start sending header in v1.4.0. Fall back: if header missing, server uses existing heuristic (avg dims * count). We'll log `embed.hint.missing` for migration visibility.

jordan: Ops/Quota: update quota calc docs — units_used = max(server_calc, declared_hint) ? I'd prefer server calc to remain authoritative to avoid abuse.

maria: Yep, authoritative = server. But console will expose a suggested unit-per-tenant metric; billing stays with server calc. We can add a reconciliation script to propose tenant credits where hints were consistently lower and legitimately correct.

lee: Rollout plan: feature-flag `embed.hint.telemetry` behind canary. Phase 1: ingest header + emit telemetry (no UI) for 1 week. Phase 2: expose dashboard heatmap to internal only. Phase 3: customer-facing console + SDK release notes. Canary to 5% tenants first.

alex: Can we add a lightweight preflight check in SDKs to compute units client-side so we reduce 413/413-like failures? Example function in JS:
```
function estimateUnits(batch) {
  // heuristics: base per-vector + dim buckets
  return batch.length * (batch[0].length <= 1024 ? 1 : 4);
}
```

sam: That example's fine as a starter. We should publish recommended heuristics in docs and a test harness in devex repo.

jordan: Telemetry cardinality risk: we must avoid storing per-vector dims at high cardinality. Use buckets and aggregate by tenant/route/time-window. Also redact any client-provided strings.

maria: Noted. Aggregation windows: 1m for perf debugging, 1h for billing/console. No per-request persistent record beyond 7d raw; aggregated 90d for trends.

deploy-bot: canary: embed-hint-telemetry v1 deployed to prod, 5% tenants, region us-west-2 :rocket:

lee: After 48h of canary we'll run a diff job: compare `hint_units` vs `actual_units` distribution per-tenant and surface top 10 mismatch tenants to the console for follow-up.

alex: Any privacy/regulatory concerns with tenant hints? Might be fine but double-check with security.

maria: I'll loop in security. Also adding a short doc snippet for sales so they don't promise customers hint-driven billing.

sam: Action items: 1) eng-runtime: ingest header and emit `embed.unit.{hint,actual}` metrics (sam). 2) eng-platform: dashboard heatmap prototype + alert rule (lee). 3) devex: SDK heuristics + release notes (alex). 4) security review for header usage (maria).

maria: Timeline suggestion: prototype in 1w, canary next week, full rollout across console + SDK in 3 weeks if no major issues. Anyone opposed?

jordan: Sounds good. I'll draft alert thresholds for mismatch and spike detection.

alex: ack — I'll start the SDK patch and add an opt-in flag so apps can opt out during migration.

maria: Thanks all. I'll post a short PR with the telemetry schema and sample payloads in #eng-platform after standup. :thumbsup:"
